$Comment: What every element Focus shares, in no set of its own: an element Focus row names it as its Parent. Kind is the
oath set's kind (TrackStances/MMOSkillTree/Mmo_Focus.json: two elements may be sworn at once, 50 max Mana each
while it stands). Line is the element's own damage bonus and Guard its own resistance, both spelt from the
row's Focus word, which is the element's damage type id (Fire: DamageBonus_Fire, DamageResist_Fire), so a pack
adding an element whose type ships writes only its Focus, Key, Home and Icon. The line counts on every hit of
LineBound, LinePlain, GuardPlain and GuardPair say which grant list the step generator writes for this kind
(Grants) and which it leaves out ($Comment, which the game ignores): an element's line is unbound and its
guard is one resistance. Leave them as they are; the step generator's own comment says why.
